archetypes.name: wire-contract
archetypes.rationale: The plan changes shell envelope fields and summary outcomes across multiple scripts where contract drift is easy to miss.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the proposed PUBLISH_OK, SESSION_ID, RUN_ID, and outcome enum changes are consistently wired across the plan, scripts, tests, and docs. Look for mismatches between fail-closed parsing, publish-skipped rendering, unknown-run-id handling, and the claimed call paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: resume-state
archetypes.rationale: The plan relies on subtle pause/resume sentinel behavior and correct attribution of the step-5c writer.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify the plan's claims about which component writes .completed/step-5c and how withholding that sentinel affects pause/resume reentry. Check whether Step 5c, Step 5d, footer cleanup, and design-pause-save behavior support the proposed retry semantics without skipping or duplicating publish work. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: caller-compat
archetypes.rationale: Changing design-log-publish --repo failures from envelope-style soft failure to exit 1 may break callers if the plan missed any.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit every in-repo caller and documented direct-use path for design-log-publish.sh to confirm the proposed --repo validation and exit-1 behavior match their expectations. Focus on whether malformed, empty, omitted, and resolved repo values are handled consistently by callers, tests, and documentation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
